== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Removes the once-per-control-phase option to take a squadron for 1 Force. The later wording explicitly supplies deploy without replacement and the same power minus three cost. Later general cancel immunity replaces the early explicit Point Man immunity, and both have Alter immunity. Dantooine deployment and No Escape conditions agree.
